label: Bible Study
prompt: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our _____; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verse: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
note: A prayer of surrender — we're the clay, and the potter is also our Father.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: _____ the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verse: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
note: With enemies threatening the wall, Nehemiah's rally cry: remember the Lord, and fight for your families.

label: Sunday School
prompt: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my _____.
verse: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
note: The origin of 'by the skin of my teeth' — Job, describing how barely he'd escaped.

label: Deep Water
prompt: (Now the man Moses was very _____, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verse: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
note: A parenthesis in the middle of Miriam and Aaron's complaint: the man they criticized was the humblest on earth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God _____.
verse: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
note: After losing everything in one day, Job worshipped: 'In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.'
